resources.string: Connect on this phone · No computer
Connect on your phone
No computer, USB or session file needed. Sign in on this device; enter a verification code at the next step if required.
The connection is used to read accessible profiles and follower/following lists. This is not an official Instagram permissions screen; the app uses your account session.
Username or email
Instagram password
Sign in

Your password is processed in memory during sign-in and is not written to files or logs. A successful session is encrypted on this device. Your previous connection and records remain until the new connection is verified.
The session has no promised expiry date. Reconnect if Instagram invalidates it. You can remove the connection through Manage connection in the app.
Account connected.
Connection information
Check your username/email and password. Empty or unsupported input was not submitted.
Instagram did not accept the credentials. No automatic retry was made; check your details and the local retry time.
Instagram did not complete this sign-in step in the supported format. No automatic retry or alternate login was attempted. Check Instagram for any additional account approval.
Code verification did not complete. Check the code and submit it again within the same open verification session.
This sign-in attempt expired or reached its step budget. Start a new sign-in when the current cooldown allows it.
Check in Instagram
The initial connection may take a few minutes. Requests follow the existing spacing; keep this screen open until it finishes. Leaving the screen cancels work in progress.
Choose a verification method enabled on your account. Enter your code when the code screen is ready; your password will not be submitted again.
Authenticator app
SMS code
Backup code
Enter the email/SMS or authenticator code requested by Instagram. You can leave this screen to retrieve the code and return without starting another login.
Verification code
Verify code
The code is used only for this open sign-in attempt and is not saved. Pending sign-in context survives screen recreation in app memory only. A complete app shutdown requires a new attempt.
